findings.problem: Counting only ADMISSION.json permits an empty claimed attempt directory to escape the two-invocation ceiling after a write failure.
findings.required_boundary: All claimed attempt directories consume the bounded attempt budget; missing evidence cannot become an implicit new run.

findings.problem: Current rank/world/output/PID/time checks do not bind the LOAD_AUDIT to the current exact export/checkpoint and strict FP32 master restoration.
findings.required_boundary: Unrelated or stale load evidence cannot release a heavy-loader slot.

findings.location: execute.launch after Popen before LAUNCH receipt
findings.problem: A receipt publication/process inspection failure occurs before the returned job is appended, allowing the just-started owned child to escape monitor cleanup.
findings.required_boundary: Track and clean the exact owned child immediately after Popen; preserve its consumed admission.

findings.location: binding storage_reservations + route_checks + immutable BINDING/resume digest
findings.problem: A storage snapshot older than300s must be refreshed after export, but refreshing it changes the globally immutable binding and resume identity, blocking legitimate later phases.
findings.required_boundary: Stable science/checkpoint/output identity must remain immutable while fresh execution resource evidence is renewed explicitly. Do not remove freshness or permit scientific identity changes.

findings.problem: A child can naturally exit between confirmed-owned active inspection and killpg, raising ESRCH and skipping EXIT receipts.
findings.required_boundary: A confirmed naturally exited owned session may be recorded as clean; other cleanup failures remain errors and unknown processes are never signaled.
